name: @aisha/postgrest-client
description: The ONE PostgREST RPC call contract shared by every AISHA orchestrator service. Replaces the divergent hand-rolled services/*/src/postgrest.ts copies (SVC-01 / D11) with a single canonical client: rpcService / rpcUser / rpcUserClaims + table helpers, preserving each service's auth / timeout semantics via options.
